title: Love, Partnership, Banks, and Insurance
summary: Relationships, finances, choices, and alternatives in life decisions.
whyItMatters: Relationships and financial services both involve trust, shared responsibilities, risk, and decisions whose consequences should be discussed carefully.

mentalModel.title: Separate emotional and practical questions
mentalModel.content: Name feelings and expectations, then examine contracts, costs, responsibilities, and risks separately.

mentalModel.title: Compare options against criteria
mentalModel.content: Evaluate alternatives by cost, flexibility, security, and suitability rather than by one attractive feature.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe expectations and responsibilities
ruleBlocks.content: Use Vertrauen, Rücksicht, gemeinsame Ziele, Verantwortung übernehmen, and Kompromisse finden.

ruleBlocks.title: Understand core banking actions
ruleBlocks.content: Use ein Konto eröffnen, Geld überweisen, einen Kredit aufnehmen, and Gebühren bezahlen.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect insurance to risk
ruleBlocks.content: Identify what is covered, the contribution, deductible, exclusions, and cancellation period.

ruleBlocks.title: Check before agreeing
ruleBlocks.content: Compare written conditions and ask what happens if circumstances change.

sentenceStructure: Distinguish facts, conditions, and personal priorities.
Use precise nouns for contractual details.
Explain the consequence of each option.

comparisons.summary: Earlier decisions and later consequences provide natural past-sequencing contexts.
The communication lesson supports cautious comparison of personal and financial options.

examples.de: In einer Partnerschaft müssen beide offen über Geld und Verantwortung sprechen.
examples.en: In a partnership, both people must speak openly about money and responsibility.

examples.de: Vor der Kontoeröffnung vergleichen wir Gebühren und Bedingungen.
examples.en: Before opening the account, we compare fees and conditions.

examples.de: Die Versicherung übernimmt den Schaden nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen.
examples.en: The insurance covers the damage only under certain conditions.

examples.de: Ein niedriger Monatsbetrag bedeutet nicht immer, dass der Kredit günstig ist.
examples.en: A low monthly payment does not always mean the loan is inexpensive.

examples.de: Für uns ist Flexibilität wichtiger als die niedrigste Gebühr.
examples.en: For us, flexibility is more important than the lowest fee.

commonMistakes.wrong: Rely on a verbal promise for a financial contract.
commonMistakes.correct: Check the written conditions and ask questions.
commonMistakes.reason: Contract details determine rights and costs.

commonMistakes.correct: Compare coverage, flexibility, exclusions, and total cost.
commonMistakes.reason: The cheapest option may not fit the need.

commonMistakes.wrong: Present one relationship model as universally correct.
commonMistakes.correct: Relate expectations to the people and situation.

tips: Create a comparison table before a financial decision.
Practice explaining one boundary and one compromise.
Mark unknown contract terms for clarification.
